about: The recall each suite must keep (ADR 0027): positive-class recall for a detector, macro recall for a multi-class agent. Set from the latest measurement (round 5 for intent, jargon and causal wording, on blind set v4), rounded down to the whole per cent; tests/test_evals.py fails when a change drops below one. figures_tool is the Tier 0 checker scored as a reviewer on the seeded memos in evals/reviewers (paragraph detection recall, with no false alarms).
